newsitem.title: INDIA: EU wants India to scrap import curbs within 2 yrs.
newsitem.headline: EU wants India to scrap import curbs within 2 yrs.

text.p: The European Union on Friday urged India to eliminate restrictions on imports within two years, saying the South Asian nation's economy was strong enough to cope with international competition.

"It is the view of the EU that the import restrictions maintained by India should be eliminated within a two-year period," the European Commission said on Friday at the end of two days of talks in the capital New Delhi.
The talks followed consultations at the World Trade Organisation (WTO) in Geneva in December 1995 and in January of this year, the commission said in a statement released in the Indian capital.

"The positive developments and the performance in the Indian economy in recent years, as confirmed by the IMF, no longer justify import restrictions for balance of payments purposes," it said, referring to the International Monetary Fund.
India has agreed to present the WTO in June with a schedule to phase out restrictions on imports.

India and the EU will meet in Brussels next month to continue their talks on the phasing out of import restrictions, it said. "Further talks are expected in the run-up to formal consultations to be resumed in June in WTO," the commission said.
